decisions.reason: This burner component remains tightly embedded in the firm's existing radiant-heating knowledge, installed base and service routines, so its strong fit with accumulated know-how makes continued improvement and retention more likely than withdrawal.

As a flagship electric line that builds directly on the firm's heating and system-integration capabilities and supports its lower-carbon strategic direction, it is very likely to be kept and further refined through in-house R&D.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is highly related to the firm's core expertise while matching its stated hydrogen-ready trajectory, so absorptive capacity and strategic commitment both point strongly toward continued commercialization.
